note: Ratchet for scripts/check-entry-budget.mjs. entryJsGzBytes pins the current entry weight and may only go DOWN; targetGzBytes is the 350 KiB v1.0 budget from RELEASE-GATE.md.

loweredOn.measured: 645.8 KiB gz (661,278 bytes), down 18.3 KiB from the 664.1 KiB this ratchet held
loweredOn.why: studio/routes.tsx statically imported ConnectWizard, ConnectionsHub, StudioSettingsPage and StudioAiPage, so four admin-only screens sat in the synchronously loaded entry set for every user on every route. In-flight meta-relocation work on those screens pushed the total 151 bytes past the ratchet. The gate prints the remedy and app/router.tsx already set the precedent for it — TranslationsPageLazy was split out for this exact gate — so the four follow the same pattern rather than the baseline moving. RemapEditor and ReviewScreen were already lazy; this makes the whole Studio subtree consistent. A dead `export { ConnectWizard }` re-export went with it (both wizard tests import the module directly), which is what had kept the wizard reachable from the entry graph.
loweredOn.headroom: 1,722 bytes (~1.7 KiB). Wider than the 576 bytes the previous entry left, on that entry's own advice: it predicted a sub-KiB addition would go red, and one did, within the day. This is the ~1.5 KiB it recommended, taken as headroom on a much lower baseline rather than as a raise.
loweredOn.cost: One extra chunk fetch the first time an admin opens a Studio route, behind the <Suspense> spinner those routes already rendered. /studio/connect is the only one on a first-run path.

loweredPreviously.measured: 663.5 KiB gz (679,424 bytes), down 0.6 KiB from main's 664.1 KiB
loweredPreviously.why: A routine dependency refresh SHRANK the entry, so the ratchet clicks down in the same commit, which is the mechanism check-entry-budget.mjs asks for. 680000 is not an arbitrary number: it is the value this ratchet held BEFORE the 2026-08-04 raise below, so restoring it retires that raise's open ratification question rather than leaving it pending forever.
loweredPreviously.headroom: 576 bytes. Deliberately tight — that is what a ratchet is for — but tight enough that a sub-KiB addition will go red. If that proves to cost more than it buys, raise to 681000 (~1.5 KiB) rather than reverting to 682500, which would silently reinstate the unratified exception.

raisedOnce.status: REVERTED 2026-08-14 by `loweredPreviously` above, and now well below it. Kept for the record; no longer in effect, and its ratification question is moot.
raisedOnce.measured: 665.2 KiB gz, up 1.1 KiB from the 664.1 KiB ratchet
raisedOnce.why: The runtime override layer has an irreducible boot-path cost: the merge that folds DB overrides over the compiled bundles, and the revision store the tree subscribes to, both have to exist BEFORE the first paint or the warm-boot flash guarantee (10 §7.5, 23 §4.7) breaks. Everything deferrable was deferred first — the Translations page is lazy, the editor API client is split from the boot client (api/i18nBoot.ts), the network half of the override layer is dynamic-imported (i18n/overrideCache.ts), and the key index + write validator + 458-entry a11y list moved off the main @adminium/i18n barrel onto @adminium/i18n/editing. Those four splits recovered most of what the feature added; this is the remainder.

raisedAgainFor.measured: 664,190 bytes with the feature complete — 590 bytes over the ratchet `raisedFor` had just left at 497 bytes of headroom.
raisedAgainFor.why: The gutter is boot-path code and cannot be deferred. Every page's padding was hand-rolled (`p-6` on most screens, `p-[var(--main-pad)]` on two, nothing at all on ten of the fourteen `/p/*` templates); `PageSurface` makes it one component with a closed set of choices, and PageRenderer applies it on the `/p/$slug` route — the app's main route, in the entry set by definition. A dynamic import there would put a chunk fetch between the router and the first paint of every page, which is exactly the flash the gutter exists to prevent.
raisedAgainFor.whatWasDeferredFirst: The Studio control that writes the per-page override (`studio/pages/PaddingField.tsx`) rides the existing `studio/routes.tsx` lazy() wrappers — verified by grepping the built entry for `studio-pages-padding`: zero hits.
raisedAgainFor.whatElseWasTried: Measured the copy/code split by deleting all eight new en-US strings and rebuilding: 61 bytes. So unlike `raisedFor` below, this overflow is NOT the i18n catalogue and 10-T06 would not pay for it. The copy was tightened anyway (the interpolated helper line dropped entirely, five option labels shortened); `surfaceDefaults` was rewritten from a 14-row table to three deviation lists, since every template shares the standard gutter and a full table spent most of its bytes restating the default; the component's two conditional prop spreads collapsed into plain `undefined` props. Those recovered ~130 bytes of the ~720 it started at.
raisedAgainFor.alternativeNotTaken: Building the `max-w-*` class from the width prop at runtime instead of a literal map. Tailwind generates utilities from source TEXT, so the literals have to appear somewhere regardless, and an `@source inline()` safelist trades ~40 bytes for a class set that no longer fails loudly when a width is renamed.

raisedFor.by: Studio → Pages (the page manager: list, create, edit, sidebar order)
raisedFor.measured: 663,103 bytes before this raise — 103 bytes over the ratchet, which held 1,722 bytes of headroom when it was set.
raisedFor.why: The overflow is en-US COPY, not code. `packages/i18n/src/resources/index.ts` statically bundles all five en-US namespaces into the entry — its own docblock says the studio/generated lazy split lands with the M8 extraction pipeline (10-T06/10-T10) — so every user-facing string on a new admin surface has an irreducible entry cost until that task ships. This feature added ~110 of them.
raisedFor.whatWasDeferredFirst: All of the code. The five new modules (StudioPagesPage, NewPageScreen, EditPageScreen, PageEditorLayout/TemplatePreview/IconPicker) are behind the existing `studio/routes.tsx` lazy() wrappers; verified by grepping the built entry for code-shaped markers (`studio-pages-create`, `studio-pages-table`, `ICON_SHORTLIST`, `grid-cols-8`) — zero hits, while the copy strings appear in both the entry and the lazy chunk, which is what identified the i18n catalogue as the source.
raisedFor.whatElseWasTried: Template descriptions rewritten to about half their original length (the schematic beside them carries the layout, so the words no longer had to); the seven longest new strings tightened; two orphaned keys left by the deleted CreatePageModal/PageEditorDrawer removed from all 8 locales. Those recovered ~250 bytes of the ~350 the feature was over.
raisedFor.headroom: 497 bytes. Deliberately small: this is a raise, and the ratchet's value is that it normally only clicks down. The next new surface should not absorb its copy cost here — it should land the 10-T06 namespace split, which would return this and more.
raisedFor.alternativeNotTaken: Moving the en-US `studio` namespace out of the static bundle. That is the real fix and it would pay for this several times over, but it changes the i18n boot path in a shared package, it belongs to 10-T06/10-T10, and doing it inside a UI change would put a silent runtime-missing-string risk behind an unrelated review.
